rules.role: Implement the supplied task; the platform owns orchestration and validation.
rules.scope: One pure Python function; controlled AST interpreter, no filesystem/network/process access.
rules.semantics: Never infer physical meaning from names alone. Use declared facts and provenance. Batch unresolved questions once; return needs_clarification before generating a candidate if critical facts are missing.
rules.adapter: Only declared rename, extraction, assembly and registered affine unit conversion. Array indexing, transpose, reshape, resampling and slicing are physical transforms, not hidden input adaptation.
rules.transforms: Declare operation, preconditions and rationale; submit independent expected verification samples covering the transform.
rules.tests: Expected values must come from supplied evidence or hand-verifiable examples, not from running your own candidate and copying its output.
rules.response: Return CandidateRequest JSON or {status: needs_clarification, questions: [...], evidence: [...]}. Do not register or apply by guessing.
rules.replacement: Capabilities are search hints only. The platform checks the concrete workflow and returns a proposal; never claim equivalence or real-device accuracy from interface compatibility.
